statement: supersedes names this rule's OWN id, so it supersedes nothing. Drives supersedes.self_referential.

First of two rules sharing an id. Drives supersedes.duplicate_ids. NOTE: neither copy carries supersedes, so this fixture does not exercise the edge-map merge; when duplicates DO carry different supersedes values the merge is LAST-write-wins, which is documented at the edge_map site in build-floor.sh.
Second rule sharing that id - must not silently replace the first.
